outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a western blot plus three bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fractions) quantifying band intensity as mean ± SD (N=4). These are bar charts of averaged data, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across purification methods with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay) with no averaged/quantified plot, so the check does not apply.
